Platinum white hair, short and bobbed with straight-cut bangs. Pale gray eyes with a stoic, neutral expression. Apparent age of a late adolescent with a mature, poised demeanor. Slender, athletic build. Signature black gothic lolita dress with a white high-collared undershirt, black stockings, and knee-high boots. A black blindfold covers the upper half of the face.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
